03/12.06.2024
 Heard the Parties.

Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Putki P.S. Case No. 80 of 2023,
registered under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 448, 376, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad.
Case diary earlier called for, has been received.
Perused the same.
Petitioner No.1 happens to be the husband and petitioner No.2 happens to be the brother-in-law of the informant.
Marriage between the petitioner No.1 and the informane was solemnized on 22.04.2022.
It is alleged that after marriage petitioner No.2 Subhash Kumar Mahato @ Subhash Kumar Mahto and his friend also established physical relationship with her.

entities.text: Subhash Kumar Mahato @ Subhash Kumar Mahto
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Thereafter, she was driven away from matrimonial home.
Mr. A. K. Kashyap, learned senior counsel for the petitioners submitted that the informant after marriage deserted her matrimonial home willfully and started living with one Pran Mahto.
Learned A.P.P. has also filed counter affidavit supporting this facts.

From perusal of the case diary,
it appears that statement of witnesses Jagdish Kumar Mahto, Taroni Das and Fagu Mahto have been recorded at paragraph Nos.57, 58 and 59 of the case diary.
These witnesses have stated that after marriage when the informant resided at her matrimonial home several persons used to visit her.
When the people of locality started questioning her chastity she left her matrimonial home.

They Yashwant Mahato vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite ... on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85045006/
1 also stated that the intimate relationship of prosecutrix with Pran Mahto was videographed.

entities.text: Yashwant Mahato vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Shekhar Prasad Sinha, learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for Anticipatory Bail.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

They are directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order, and in the event of their arrest or surrender they shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad in connection with Putki P.S. Case No. 80 of 2023, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
